title: Lightweight Representation Learning for Low Tucker Rank Tensors
abstract: arXiv:2611.01168v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Iterative estimators for low Tucker rank tensors, such as HOOI, nuclear-norm proximal and ADMM methods, Frank-Wolfe and scaled gradient descent, form large objects in every iteration: unfoldings, Kronecker operators, full SVDs and ambient iterates. The update uses little of these objects, yet they make memory the limiting resource on large tensors and on edge-sized devices. Remedies for each of these costs are known. However, it is unclear when a rewriting keeps the iterates unchanged, and where it pays off against efficient implementations. We therefore present a trajectory-preserving lightweight evaluation. First, we state exactness as an intertwining relation between the stored state and the reference iteration. Second, we show that three known components satisfy this relation for five estimators: computing only the singular triplets that an update needs, contracting without Kronecker products, and storing sparse-plus-factor

translated_title: 面向低Tucker秩张量的轻量级表示学习
translated_abstract: 用于低Tucker秩张量的迭代估计器，例如HOOI、核范数近端与ADMM方法、Frank-Wolfe以及缩放梯度下降，在每次迭代中都会构建大型对象：矩阵展开、Kronecker算子、完整的SVD分解以及环境维度的迭代变量。更新过程仅使用这些对象的一小部分，但它们却使内存成为处理大规模张量以及在边缘设备上的限制性资源。针对其中每种开销的补救方法都是已知的。然而，人们并不清楚什么样的重写能够保持迭代轨迹不变，以及这些重写在面对高效实现时于何处能带来收益。因此，我们提出了一种保持轨迹不变的轻量化计算方法。首先，我们将精确性表述为存储状态与参考迭代之间的交织关系。其次，我们证明了三个已知组件在五个估计器上均满足这一关系：仅计算更新所需的奇异三元组、无需Kronecker乘积的收缩运算，以及存储稀疏加因子（sparse-plus-factor）形式的……
tldr: 本文提出了一种保持迭代轨迹不变的轻量化计算框架，通过仅计算更新所需的奇异三元组、避免Kronecker乘积的收缩以及稀疏加因子存储三个组件，显著降低了五种低Tucker秩张量迭代估计器的内存开销。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a trajectory-preserving lightweight evaluation framework that, through three components—computing only the needed singular triplets, contracting without Kronecker products, and sparse-plus-factor storage—substantially reduces memory costs for five iterative estimators of low Tucker rank tensors.
